purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of empirical earthquake ground-motion observation sources relevant to catastrophe-risk validation.

entries.name: Engineering Strong-Motion Database (ESM) v3.0
entries.provider: ORFEUS Strong-Motion SMC / Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia
entries.spatial_scope: mainly European-Mediterranean regions and the Middle East
entries.temporal_scope: reviewed accelerometric records from qualifying events since 1969; ESM v3.0 released March 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: record-level raw and processed strong-motion waveforms, response spectra, intensity measures and associated event/station metadata
entries.note: ESM v3.0 reprocessed the database with updated processing and quality-control strategies and exposes record quality metadata. The ESM database states CC BY 4.0, but individual waveform/spectrum licences are provider-specific; preserve record licence, processing state, quality class/warnings and version before any admission or redistribution decision.
